MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 7

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 12

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

11. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

3. A — 8
Working:

Final Answer: x = 8
